purpose: Negative / hard-negative synthetic clips for MischiefCam development, matching the scene of the positive clip Dog_chewing_living_room_sofa.

generation_defaults.vary_between_clips: dog position, timing of the action, small lighting changes
generation_defaults.note: Exclusions are written into each prompt; use negative_prompt only if the generator has that field.

negative_prompt: For tools with a separate negative-prompt field: chewing furniture, biting sofa, torn fabric, stuffing, foam, destroyed cushion, camera shake, cuts, text, watermark, cartoon
labeling_rules: Label each generated clip from what is actually visible, not from the prompt: generators sometimes add chewing or stuffing.
Discard or relabel clips where the dog bites the sofa, or where torn fabric/stuffing appears.
Mark these clips simulated: yes, consent_or_license: <generator name + terms checked>.
Disclose synthetic clips in the deck and video; keep them separate from real recordings in reports.
